summary: Belite Bio, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results and a corporate update. The release highlights FDA acceptance of its New Drug Application with Priority Review for tinlarebant in Stargardt disease type 1, with a PDUFA target action date of February 12, 2027. Additional positive secondary endpoint data from the Phase 3 DRAGON trial were presented at ASRS. No special-situation transaction, such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring, is disclosed. The filing is routine financial reporting and operational update, with no event warranting special-situations classification.
